description: Decrypt a sealed value from crypto_seal / crypto_encrypt. sealed may be: (1) an object with iv, tag, and ciphertext as base64Binary/hexBinary or as base64/hex strings; (2) a string of pure JSON with those properties as base64 strings (e.g. after stringify of a JSON-friendly object). Returns plaintext octets. Requires execute access.

parameters.description: Key material, CryptoKey, or key reference.
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Sealed object or pure JSON string.
parameters.name: sealed

returns.description: Plaintext octets. Use decode_to_string() for UTF-8 text.
